answer: Gate identity creation behind a proof-of-work stamp and a per-address rate limit, so registrations arrive in a thin plume instead of a flood. Each new wallet must mine a puzzle whose difficulty climbs in a spiral as more identities appear from one source, turning mass minting into a narrow jetty the attacker cannot widen cheaply. An honest newcomer pays a small one-time cost; a sybil farm pays it multiplied by every clone, which quickly becomes uneconomic.
